documents.title: AI in Design Report 2026 - Chapter 1: Tools
documents.summary: Weekly AI usage among designers jumped from 54% to 91% in a year, and the average toolstack doubled from 3 to 7 tools. Claude has overtaken ChatGPT, Figma's role is shifting, and a growing number of designers are building their own bespoke tools.

documents.title: AI in Design Report 2026 - Chapter 2: Craft
documents.summary: Half of surveyed designers now ship AI-generated code to production, and working prototypes have become an expected deliverable. The chapter weighs AI's speed gains against worries about cutting corners, and finds designers still trust human taste and judgment over AI.

documents.title: AI in Design Report 2026 - Chapter 3: Teams
documents.summary: Companies are investing more in AI adoption, but designers still learn the most from one another. Roles across design, product, and engineering are blurring, expectations are rising faster than company policy, and most leaders expect to keep or grow design headcount.
